releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.23 pauses OCR and Smart Search Index so the app is lighter and simpler again. Settings no longer shows Smart Search Index or OCR-based document expiry analysis. File search remains available by filename and file type. Documents now use a normal camera photo with no OCR or OpenCV scan processing, while saved-document preview, rename, category and share remain available. OCR models, ONNX/Paddle/EasyOCR/Tesseract payloads and OCR-only dependencies are removed from the Android build. The v0.11.22 persistent-tab navigation fix is preserved.
